formLabels.calcFieldDesc_year: Extracts the year from a date.
formLabels.calcFieldDesc_month: Extracts the month (1-12) from a date.
formLabels.calcFieldDesc_day: Extracts the day (1-31) from a date.
formLabels.calcFieldDesc_date_diff: Calculates the difference between two dates in the specified unit. Part can be 'day', 'month', 'year', etc.
formLabels.calcFieldDesc_date_trunc: Truncates a date to the specified precision. Useful for aligning dates before aggregation by year/month/day.
formLabels.calcFieldDesc_parse_date: Parses a string into a date using strptime format syntax. Formats like '%Y-%m-%d', '%Y%m%d'.
formLabels.calcFieldDesc_current_date: Returns the current system date. No arguments.
formLabels.calcFieldDesc_now: Returns the current system date and time. No arguments.
formLabels.calcFieldDesc_dense_rank: Returns the dense rank of rows within a partition, without gaps (e.g. 1,1,2,3).
formLabels.calcFieldDesc_ntile: Divides rows in a partition into N buckets as evenly as possible. Returns the bucket number (1 to N).
formLabels.calcFieldDesc_first_value: Returns the value from the first row of the window frame. Requires ORDER BY for deterministic results.
formLabels.calcFieldDesc_last_value: Returns the value from the last row of the window frame. Requires ORDER BY for deterministic results.
formLabels.calcFieldDesc_ceil: Rounds up to the nearest integer greater than or equal to the argument.
formLabels.calcFieldDesc_floor: Rounds down to the nearest integer less than or equal to the argument.
formLabels.calcFieldDesc_contains: Checks if a string contains a substring. Returns boolean.
formLabels.calcFieldDesc_starts_with: Checks if a string starts with a given prefix. Returns boolean.
formLabels.calcFieldDesc_ends_with: Checks if a string ends with a given suffix. Returns boolean.
formLabels.calcFieldDesc_replace: Replaces all occurrences of a substring in a string with a new string.
formLabels.calcFieldDesc_regexp_replace: Replaces substrings matching a regex pattern in a string.
formLabels.calcFieldDesc_lpad: Left-pads a string with a specified character to reach the target length.
formLabels.calcFieldDesc_rpad: Right-pads a string with a specified character to reach the target length.
formLabels.calcFieldDesc_reverse: Reverses the characters in a string.
formLabels.calcFieldDesc_repeat: Repeats a string a specified number of times.
formLabels.calcFieldDesc_try_cast: Safely converts an expression to the specified type. Returns NULL on failure instead of throwing an error. Can be used to parse a string into a number, e.g. try_cast([revenue] AS double).
formLabels.calcFieldDesc_rowNumber: Assigns a unique sequential number to each row within a partition, starting at 1. Requires ORDER BY in the OVER clause for deterministic ordering.
formLabels.calcFieldDesc_rank: Returns the rank of each row within a partition, with gaps when values are tied (e.g. 1, 1, 3, 4).
formLabels.calcFieldDesc_lag: Returns the value from the N-th preceding row within the partition. Default offset is 1. Useful for calculating day-over-day changes or differences from previous records.
formLabels.calcFieldDesc_lead: Returns the value from the N-th following row within the partition. Default offset is 1. Useful for accessing values from subsequent records.
formLabels.calcFieldDesc_sum: Sums up the values of a numeric field, ignoring nulls. Commonly used for totals, revenue, and aggregated amounts.
formLabels.calcFieldDesc_avg: Calculates the average of a numeric field, ignoring nulls. Suitable for averages, mean scores, and daily averages.
formLabels.calcFieldDesc_count: Counts non-null rows. count(*) returns total rows, count([field]) returns rows where the field is not null.
formLabels.calcFieldDesc_min: Returns the minimum value of a numeric or date field, ignoring nulls.
formLabels.calcFieldDesc_max: Returns the maximum value of a numeric or date field, ignoring nulls.
formLabels.calcFieldDesc_abs: Returns the absolute value of a number. Useful for calculating deviations and magnitude of differences.
formLabels.calcFieldDesc_round: Rounds a number to the specified decimal places. Defaults to integer when precision is omitted.
formLabels.calcFieldDesc_trim: Removes leading and trailing whitespace (spaces, tabs, newlines) from a string.
formLabels.calcFieldDesc_length: Returns the number of characters in a string (not bytes).
formLabels.calcFieldDesc_substr: Extracts a substring starting at the given position. Position is 1-based. Length is optional.
formLabels.calcFieldDesc_splitPart: Splits a string by delimiter and returns the N-th part (1-based). e.g. split_part('a,b,c', ',', 2) → 'b'.
formLabels.calcFieldDesc_concat: Concatenates multiple strings into one. Accepts any number of arguments.
formLabels.calcFieldDesc_coalesce: Returns the first non-null value from left to right. Commonly used to provide default or fallback values.
formLabels.calcFieldDesc_nullif: Returns NULL if the two arguments are equal, otherwise returns the first argument.
formLabels.calcFieldDesc_cast: Converts an expression to the specified type. Supports string, int, double, date, timestamp, boolean, etc. Returns NULL on conversion failure.
